note: Questions needed before a decision can be made reasonably. 'Known' lists what the repository and the verified sources already show. Blank means no answer is available.

questions.question: Which product does each supplied short link lead to, in terms of ASIN and listing URL?
questions.known: Four short links resolve to a product page, one to a checkpoint page. The four product ASINs observed are B0CDY277D3, B09B7SB46R, B08DKYBTPH and B0DZFD6R9Z. The supplied codes are 9 characters long.
questions.discover_by: Owner confirms the intended product, or supplies the full product URL or ASIN for each link.

questions.question: Are the supplied short links acceptable under the Associates policies?
questions.known: The brief says the status is unresolved (FLG-003). The Operating Agreement defines Special Links as tagged formats Amazon provides. The policies list disqualifications for redirecting and improperly formatted links, and this check read those parts only.
questions.discover_by: Run T-LINK: test one link per product in the enrolled Associates account and compare the destination and tracking report. Review Policies Section 2(e) and (g) with the owner.

questions.question: Do purchases through the supplied links attribute to shopnow047c-20?
questions.known: The observed final URLs carry no tag= parameter.
questions.discover_by: T-LINK: click one link per product in the enrolled account and check the tracking report.

questions.question: Is shopnow047c-20 enrolled and active in the Associates account?
questions.known: Not checked. The check did not sign in.
questions.discover_by: Owner checks Account Settings in Associates Central.

questions.question: What are the current price, rating and availability of each product?
questions.known: Not verified for any product.
questions.discover_by: Dated snapshots from the official listing, or an authorized product data feed.

questions.question: What commission rate applies to each product's category?

questions.question: Which five events are the 'defined events' in the brief?
questions.known: The brief refers to five defined events but does not list them. Five names are proposed on the Measurement page.

questions.question: Where does the analytics endpoint run?
questions.known: GitHub Pages serves static files and cannot run a server endpoint.
questions.discover_by: Owner picks a host for the endpoint, or keeps measurement off.

questions.question: Is GitHub Pages acceptable for this site under GitHub's limits?
questions.known: The limits page says Pages is not for sites primarily directed at commercial transactions. Whether this site falls under that is not decided by this build.
questions.discover_by: Owner decides, or asks GitHub Support for a view.

questions.question: Who is the author, and what is their role?

questions.discover_by: Owner supplies the byline text or confirms the site stays unsigned.

questions.question: How often should guides be published?
questions.known: No cadence was given.

questions.question: Which topics attract readers, and in which queries?

questions.known: P-05 is a smart meat thermometer. The working titles do not cover it.

questions.question: Which Pages layout should the repository publish: /docs (this session) or root (the other session)?
questions.known: Pages currently publishes main:/. The other session plans a root site. This build uses /docs.
